## Four-year scope covers two offshore rigs on the Norwegian Continental Shelf


**HOUSTON, November 12, 2026 —** Global energy technology company SLB (NYSE: SLB) today announced it has been selected by Vår Energi as its main integrated drilling services supplier for the Transocean Barents and Deepsea Bergen rigs on the Norwegian Continental Shelf.


The selection covers an initial four-year period, with four additional one-year extension options that could extend the scope through 2034. Two harsh-environment semisubmersibles will continuously drill exploration and development wells during this period.


The integrated delivery model brings together technical expertise, digital workflows and operational execution across the well delivery process. Working closely with Vår Energi and other selected service and technology providers, SLB will connect planning and execution, simplify interfaces, and use data to support faster decisions and more consistent well performance.


The selection also expands SLB’s role in Vår Energi’s offshore operations, adding integrated drilling services to an established relationship spanning digital well and field development planning and subsea production systems through SLB’s OneSubsea™ joint venture.


“Creating greater value on the Norwegian Continental Shelf requires us to challenge traditional ways of working,” said Torger Rød, chief operating officer of Vår Energi. “By connecting planning and execution and bringing together expertise, technology and data, we can work across traditional boundaries to deliver wells faster, more predictably and with greater value.”


“We value the trust Vår Energi has placed in us,” said ND Maduemezia, president, Europe and Africa, SLB. “Our focus now is on differentiated execution, combining technology, technical expertise, operating discipline and digital capabilities to deliver consistently high performance at scale.”


### Key Points:


- SLB has been selected by Vår Energi as its main integrated drilling services supplier for two offshore rigs on the Norwegian Continental Shelf.
- The initial four-year scope includes four one-year extension options that could extend the work through 2034.
- The selection expands SLB’s relationship with Vår Energi across drilling, digital well and field development planning, and subsea production systems.
